Police Mobile Directory

Officer & Employee Mobile App Registration Guide (Page 1 of 2)

Overview

The Police Mobile Directory (PMD) is a secure communication and employee information platform exclusively for verified Karnataka State Police personnel. The application provides access to employee contacts, departmental directories, leave management, official documents, and other utility services.

PMD Dashboard Features

Once registered and authorized, users gain access to the following tools directly from the PMD Dashboard:

📞 Telephone Directory

Search and instantly contact registered Karnataka State Police personnel and official departmental contacts using KGID, Name, Mobile Number, Rank, Designation, Unit, District, or Station.

➜ Smart Search: Search by Name, KGID, Mobile, Rank, Designation, or Posting.
➜ Registered Users: View profile and contact details of registered PMD users.
➜ Quick Communication: Quick Call, SMS, WhatsApp, and Email options (where available).
➜ Coordinated Contacts: Access official numbers, regularly updated for seamless communication.
📅 Leave Manager

Maintain leave records and view balances for EL, HPL, and CL.

🤖 AI Pay Slip Parser

AI-powered payslip parsing with Google Drive backup and Excel export.

🔤 Nudi Converter

Convert Kannada Unicode ↔ Nudi (ASCII). Supports TXT, PDF, DOCX.

🖼️ Gallery

Browse departmental event photographs and official media galleries.

📄 Documents & Circulars

Download and search GOs, circulars, rules, and official forms.

🔗 Useful Links

Quick access to KSP Apps, Karnataka State Portals, and Central Govt Services.

Registration Pre-requisites & Support
🔑KGID Number: Ensure to give proper KGID number this is the key in database to maintain data.
📱Mobile Number: The mobile number used during registration will publish in app and will be used for communication.[CUG mobile number Disabled for Registration]
⏳Verification: Registration requests are reviewed by authorized PMD administrators. Approval generally takes 24–48 hours.
✉️Support Helpline: For any registration issues, email us at noreply.pmdapp@gmail.com.
Step 1: Link Google Account
1 Install App from playstore using below provided link or QR code.
2 Launch the PMD mobile application on your device.
3 Choose your desired Google account in the Google chooser popup.
Step 2: Submit Registration Dialog
  • 4 If your Google account is unrecognized, a dialog prompt will ask: 'Do you wish to submit a registration request?'
  • 5 Verify the email matches, then tap Register to open the registration form.
Alternative Login Option

For offline access, you can use the Email and PIN login card. Note the "For Offline Use" label positioned directly above the card.

Note: PIN sign-in is only available after your initial Google registration has been approved by the administrators.

Officer & Employee Mobile App Registration Guide (Page 2 of 2)

Step 3: Fill Registration Form

Fill out the required information with absolute accuracy to ensure quick administrative approval:

Field Requirement Description & Validation Rules
📸 Profile Photo REQUIRED Tap "Add Photo" to snap a camera shot or upload from gallery.
👤 Name REQUIRED Must match your official service record name.
✉️ Email AUTO-FILLED LOCKED Automatically fetched from your Google account. This field cannot be modified after registration.
📱 Mobile 1 REQUIRED Enter active 10 digit phone number.
🏢 Unit & District REQUIRED Dropdown selection. Options filter automatically based on unit.
🎖️ KGID & Rank REQUIRED Unique govt insurance number & service rank dropdown.
👮 Station / Branch REQUIRED Lists stations inside your District. Use "Others" if not listed.
🩸 Blood Group REQUIRED Select your blood group. Visible on your profile card.
🔒 6-Digit PIN REQUIRED Create and confirm your numeric PIN for Offline Login.
Step 4: Submission & Admin Approval

Check the Terms and Conditions checkbox and tap Submit for approval.
